newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot ethanes lower to steady, majors sell.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot ethanes lower to steady, majors sell.

text.p: U.S. spot ethane prices were mostly lower to steady in thin trade late on Friday amid selling by a major petrochemical company that was long on the material, traders said.
In the Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, purity ethane dropped a half cent to between 29.00 cents and 29.25 cents a gallon with deals done in the range, players said.
Belvieu ethane mix fell to a penny under purity, and Conway, Kansas, hub material stayed steady.
Traders attributed the drop to selling by a Houston-based petchem that is periodically long on ethane.
The sell was the second time this week that a petchem has dumped some barrels of the material on the market.
Belvieu propane, however, remained largely steady at 48.75/49.25 cents, widening the already long spread to ethane.
Players said activity was very light, but could not attribute a cause.
-- Laney Salisbury New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
